question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To cross swords
solution:
The correct answer is: '**To fight**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To cross swords"** means to engage in a conflict or dispute with someone. (किसी के साथ संघर्ष या विवाद में शामिल होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The two politicians often **cross swords** during debates.
 
 
 
• **"To fight"** refers to taking part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. (लड़ाई करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The knights were ready **to fight** to defend their castle.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To kill** (मार डालना): To cause the death of a person, animal, or other living thing.

 
 
• **Example:** The hunter aimed **to kill** the deer with one shot.
 
 
 
• **To arrange** (व्यवस्थित करना): To put things in a neat, attractive, or required order.
 
 
• **Example:** She took time **to arrange** the flowers in a beautiful bouquet.
 
 
 
• **To defend** (रक्षा करना): To protect someone or something from attack or harm.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were prepared **to defend** their country at any cost.
